claims.claim: Dealer in all kinds of Japanese parts and gearbox
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a used drivetrain/engine-gearbox assembly but do not confirm the seller’s business type.
No readable import/serial/plate or documentation is shown in the photos.
Photos show a dusty used assembly; there is no running/test evidence, no test sheet, and no video/indicator of operation.
No audio/video of the unit running is provided; photos cannot confirm knocking.
No mileage/odometer/engine code or internal wear indicators with documentation are readable in the photos.
Photos do not show tamper-proof seals, opening marks, or documentation that would confirm it was never opened.

risks.risk: Compatibility risk: the exact make/model/engine code and gearbox type are not visible, so it may not fit the buyer’s vehicle.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine code/gearbox model plate (or stamped ID) plus the full part number label, taken straight-on and readable.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used drivetrain/gearbox assembly with unknown compatibility.

risks.risk: Missing/partial assembly risk: photos may not show whether key components are included (starter, alternator, turbo, ECU, sensors, mounts, linkage).
risks.proof: A full laid-out inventory photo/video showing every included component and what is not included, with close-ups of connectors and mounting points.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst case: missing critical accessories).

risks.risk: Operational health risk: “tested/working/no knock” cannot be verified from photos; internal bearings/gears/timing (engine) and shift quality (gearbox) may be worn.
risks.proof: A short video of the unit running under load (or at least start-up) plus a test report showing results (oil pressure/temperature/scan if applicable).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst case: may require overhaul).

risks.risk: Leak risk: photos do not clearly show leak sources; oil/coolant/gear oil leaks may exist after installation.
risks.proof: Cleaned/washed unit with close-up photos of all seams, drain plugs, and gasket lines, plus a clip showing no fresh seepage after a short run.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potential leak/unknown seal condition.

risks.risk: Condition/repair history risk: “never opened” and “no knock” are not verifiable; it could have been repaired or opened previously.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of fasteners, gasket edges, sealant lines, and any tamper marks; plus receipts/work order if claimed.

risks.risk: Identification/documentation risk: “Tokunbo direct from Belgium” is not supported by any readable plate or paperwork in the photos.
risks.proof: Clear photos of import documents or a readable serial/ID plate and part number matching the paperwork.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as standard used (not proven tokunbo/import).

proof_requests: Send clear, readable photos of the engine code and gearbox model/serial plate (straight-on, high resolution).
Confirm and photograph the full list of included parts (starter, alternator, turbo if any, ECU, sensors, mounts, linkage, wiring harness, cooling lines).
Provide a video of the unit starting/running (or a test video) and any test sheet/scan results.
Show close-ups of all gasket/seam areas and drain plugs after cleaning, and confirm whether any leaks were present before removal.
Provide evidence for “never opened” (tamper marks/seal condition) and any receipts/work history if available.
response.reason: The witness can identify it only as a used engine/gearbox drivetrain assembly, but key details needed to price safely in Rivers (exact compatibility, completeness, and proven working condition) are not visible or verifiable from the photos.
